name: archive
summary: Archives all the messages of a batch into a single message according to the selected archive format.

name: avro
summary: Performs Avro based operations on messages based on a schema.

name: awk
summary: Executes an AWK program on messages. This processor is very powerful as it offers a range of [custom functions](#awk-functions) for querying and mutating message contents and metadata.

name: aws_bedrock_invoke
summary: Invokes an Amazon Bedrock model for each message, replacing the message contents with the raw model response.

name: aws_dynamodb_partiql
summary: Executes a PartiQL expression against a DynamoDB table for each message.

name: aws_lambda
summary: Invokes an AWS lambda for each message. The contents of the message is the payload of the request, and the result of the invocation will become the new contents of the message.

name: aws_s3
summary: Performs an S3 GetObject operation using the `bucket` + `key` provided in the config and replaces the original message parts with the content retrieved from S3.

name: azure_cosmosdb
summary: Creates or updates messages as JSON documents in [Azure CosmosDB](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cosmos-db/introduction).

name: bloblang
summary: Executes a [Bloblang](/docs/guides/bloblang/about) mapping on messages.

name: bounds_check
summary: Removes messages (and batches) that do not fit within certain size boundaries.

name: branch
summary: The `branch` processor allows you to create a new request message via a [Bloblang mapping](/docs/guides/bloblang/about), execute a list of processors on the request messages, and, finally, map the res

name: cache
summary: Performs operations against a [cache resource](/docs/components/caches/about) for each message, allowing you to store or retrieve data within message payloads.

name: cached
summary: Cache the result of applying one or more processors to messages identified by a key. If the key already exists within the cache the contents of the message will be replaced with the cached result inst

name: catch
summary: Applies a list of child processors _only_ when a previous processing step has failed.

name: compress
summary: Compresses messages according to the selected algorithm. Supported compression algorithms are: [flate gzip lz4 pgzip snappy zlib]

name: couchbase
summary: Performs operations against Couchbase for each message, allowing you to store or retrieve data within message payloads.

name: decompress
summary: Decompresses messages according to the selected algorithm. Supported decompression algorithms are: [bzip2 flate gzip lz4 pgzip snappy zlib]

name: dedupe
summary: Deduplicates messages by storing a key value in a cache using the `add` operator. If the key already exists within the cache it is dropped.

name: elasticsearch
summary: Queries Elasticsearch and replaces messages with the result.

name: file
summary: Performs operations (read, write, delete, move, rename, stat) on files.

name: for_each
summary: A processor that applies a list of child processors to messages of a batch as though they were each a batch of one message.

name: gcp_bigquery_select
summary: Executes a `SELECT` query against BigQuery and replaces messages with the rows returned.

name: grok
summary: Parses messages into a structured format by attempting to apply a list of Grok expressions, the first expression to result in at least one value replaces the original message with a JSON object contai

name: group_by
summary: Splits a [batch of messages](/docs/configuration/batching) into N batches, where each resulting batch contains a group of messages determined by a [Bloblang query](/docs/guides/bloblang/about).

name: group_by_value
summary: Splits a batch of messages into N batches, where each resulting batch contains a group of messages determined by a [function interpolated string](/docs/configuration/interpolation#bloblang-queries) ev

name: http
summary: Performs an HTTP request using a message batch as the request body, and replaces the original message parts with the body of the response.

name: insert_part
summary: Insert a new message into a batch at an index. If the specified index is greater than the length of the existing batch it will be appended to the end.

name: javascript
summary: Executes a provided JavaScript code block or file for each message.

name: jmespath
summary: Executes a [JMESPath query](http://jmespath.org/) on JSON documents and replaces the message with the resulting document.

name: jq
summary: Transforms and filters messages using jq queries.

name: json_schema
summary: Checks messages against a provided JSONSchema definition but does not change the payload under any circumstances. If a message does not match the schema it can be caught using error handling methods o

name: log
summary: Prints a log event for each message. Messages always remain unchanged. The log message can be set using function interpolations described [here](/docs/configuration/interpolation#bloblang-queries) whi

name: mapping
summary: Executes a [Bloblang](/docs/guides/bloblang/about) mapping on messages, creating a new document that replaces (or filters) the original message.

name: metric
summary: Emit custom metrics by extracting values from messages.

name: mongodb
summary: Performs operations against MongoDB for each message, allowing you to store or retrieve data within message payloads.

name: msgpack
summary: Converts messages to or from the [MessagePack](https://msgpack.org/) format.

name: mutation
summary: Executes a [Bloblang](/docs/guides/bloblang/about) mapping and directly transforms the contents of messages, mutating (or deleting) them.

name: nats_kv
summary: Perform operations on a NATS key-value bucket.

name: nats_object_store
summary: Perform operations on a NATS object store bucket.

name: nats_request_reply
summary: Sends a message to a NATS subject and expects a reply, from a NATS subscriber acting as a responder, back.

name: nlp_classify_text
summary: Performs text classification using a Hugging Face 🤗 NLP pipeline with an ONNX Runtime model.

name: nlp_classify_tokens
summary: Performs token classification using a Hugging Face 🤗 NLP pipeline with an ONNX Runtime model.

name: nlp_extract_features
summary: Performs feature extraction using a Hugging Face 🤗 NLP pipeline with an ONNX Runtime model.

name: nlp_zero_shot_classify
summary: Performs zero-shot text classification using a Hugging Face 🤗 NLP pipeline with an ONNX Runtime model.

name: noop
summary: Noop is a processor that does nothing, the message passes through unchanged. Why? Sometimes doing nothing is the braver option.

name: opensnowcat
summary: Processes [OpenSnowcat](https://opensnowcat.io/)/[Snowplow enriched TSV](https://docs.snowplow.io/docs/fundamentals/canonical-event/understanding-the-enriched-tsv-format/) events. Convert enriched TSV

name: parallel
summary: A processor that applies a list of child processors to messages of a batch as though they were each a batch of one message (similar to the [`for_each`](/docs/components/processors/for_each) processor)

name: parquet_decode
summary: Decodes [Parquet files](https://parquet.apache.org/docs/) into a batch of structured messages.

name: parquet_encode
summary: Encodes [Parquet files](https://parquet.apache.org/docs/) from a batch of structured messages.

name: parse_log
summary: Parses common log [formats](#formats) into [structured data](#codecs). This is easier and often much faster than [`grok`](/docs/components/processors/grok).

name: processors
summary: A processor grouping several sub-processors.

name: rate_limit
summary: Throttles the throughput of a pipeline according to a specified [`rate_limit`](/docs/components/rate_limits/about) resource. Rate limits are shared across components and therefore apply globally to al

name: redis
summary: Performs actions against Redis that aren't possible using a [`cache`](/docs/components/processors/cache) processor. Actions are

name: redis_script
summary: Performs actions against Redis using [LUA scripts](https://redis.io/docs/manual/programmability/eval-intro/).

name: resource
summary: Resource is a processor type that runs a processor resource identified by its label.

name: retry
summary: Attempts to execute a series of child processors until success.

name: schema_registry_decode
summary: Automatically decodes and validates messages with schemas from a Confluent Schema Registry service.

name: schema_registry_encode
summary: Automatically encodes and validates messages with schemas from a Confluent Schema Registry service.

name: select_parts
summary: Cherry pick a set of messages from a batch by their index. Indexes larger than the number of messages are simply ignored.

name: sentry_capture
summary: Captures log events from messages and submits them to [Sentry](https://sentry.io/).

name: sleep
summary: Sleep for a period of time specified as a duration string for each message. This processor will interpolate functions within the `duration` field, you can find a list of functions [here](/docs/configu

name: split
summary: Breaks message batches (synonymous with multiple part messages) into smaller batches. The size of the resulting batches are determined either by a discrete size or, if the field `byte_size` is non-zer

name: sql_insert
summary: Inserts rows into an SQL database for each message, and leaves the message unchanged.

name: sql_raw
summary: Runs an arbitrary SQL query against a database and (optionally) returns the result as an array of objects, one for each row returned.

name: sql_select
summary: Runs an SQL select query against a database and returns the result as an array of objects, one for each row returned, containing a key for each column queried and its value.

name: switch
summary: Conditionally processes messages based on their contents.

name: sync_response
summary: Adds the payload in its current state as a synchronous response to the input source, where it is dealt with according to that specific input type.

name: template
summary: Transforms messages using Go template syntax.

name: try
summary: Executes a list of child processors on messages only if no prior processors have failed (or the errors have been cleared).

name: unarchive
summary: Unarchives messages according to the selected archive format into multiple messages within a [batch](/docs/configuration/batching).

name: while
summary: A processor that checks a [Bloblang query](/docs/guides/bloblang/about/) against each batch of messages and executes child processors on them for as long as the query resolves to true.

name: workflow
summary: Executes a topology of [`branch` processors][processors.branch], performing them in parallel where possible.

name: xml
summary: Parses messages as an XML document, performs a mutation on the data, and then overwrites the previous contents with the new value.
